name: leg bench side bridge
description: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench. It hits the obliques and builds side-body stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench.
Place your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your hips stacked and your core tight.
Lower and repeat on the other side.
